sprites.robot: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent JRPG sprite atlas. References: first image is avatar identity and four transport poses, second image is mascot identity. Generate a NEW high-resolution SNES-inspired modern JRPG sprite sheet preserving these identities: mint-green friendly round robot with yellow chest core and antenna; one small ivory-and-cyan hovering drone mascot with a dark expressive face screen. EXACT rigid grid: 6 equal columns by 4 equal rows, landscape 3:2, ideally 1536x1024 or larger integer multiple, NO margins between cells, no lines, no labels, no background. Each cell has exactly one avatar and its one mascot grouped as ONE sprite, wholly inside cell, common baseline, consistent size within its row, transparent negative space, polished pixel-painted JRPG outlines and detailed shaded color. ROWS top to bottom: row 1 walking; row 2 riding a yellow bicycle with mascot carried safely or hovering alongside; row 3 sitting INSIDE a red-and-cream German tram with mascot in adjacent window; row 4 driving INSIDE a small red car with mascot in adjacent passenger window. Avatar face must remain clearly visible in all modes. COLUMNS left to right: 1 strong disgust/frowning face, narrow annoyed eyes, scrunched nose, downturned mouth; 2 same disgust character alternative gait/wheel pose; 3 neutral calm face; 4 neutral alternative gait/wheel pose; 5 pleasure, delighted smiling face, happy curved eyes and rosy cheeks; 6 same delighted character alternative gait/wheel pose. Mascot shows same disgust/neutral/joy as character in its respective columns. All cells must contain the requested mode, never turn vehicle cells into portraits. Keep avatar and pet count exactly one per cell. No floating hearts, no smoke, no text: these will be composited as runtime anime effects. No duplicate avatars, no detached heads, no unrelated characters. Preserve recognizability of all four transport types.

backgrounds.walk: Use the attached photograph as architectural reference for the actual Jahrtausendturm in Elbauenpark Magdeburg. Recognizable tall off-white conical tower with structural ribs, pointed cap and red-brown spiral exterior ramp. Compose tower centered at x=.50 with apex y=.08 and base y=.86, occupying width .45 near base. Show the exterior ramp visibly winding around the cone in 3 broad continuous turns, clear walkway surface and railings; clean front arcs at y=.78, .59 and .40. Trees and landscaped park surround it. Ground path in lower 15%. Do not obscure ramps with foreground trees. The sprite will walk up the exterior spiral, becoming smaller as it climbs; design coherent perspective.
backgrounds.bike: Use attached harbor photograph as the reference for Wissenschaftshafen Magdeburg. View from a quay path at human eye level toward the distinctive pale-yellow former warehouse Denkfabrik with stepped red-tile roofs, historic harbor cranes, adjacent brick research buildings and water basin. Main buildings upper 60%, visible harbor water band y=.60-.75 with fine reflections. A broad continuous stone cycling promenade across lower 25% is unobstructed and flat. Optional accurate small facade text 'DENKFABRIK'. Keep real architectural identity recognizable, not a generic fantasy city.
backgrounds.pt: Both photographs reference the real Otto-von-Guericke-Universität Universitätsbibliothek Magdeburg; preserve the distinctive broad horizontal glass building, pale curved cantilevered roof, slender concrete columns and ochre yellow facade panels. View from the front street at human eye level; building upper 65%, public street with two tram rails crossing horizontally in lower 25%. No tram in background. Keep facade identifiable with clean accurate lettering 'OVGU' and 'Universitätsbibliothek' on an entrance sign, no fabricated university seal. Trees either side, sunlight glints in glazing.
backgrounds.car: Use attached reference of Quedlinburg Marktplatz: exact recognizable ensemble of golden half-timbered Fachwerk house with dark beams and flower boxes on left, ivy-clad historic Rathaus with pointed roof towers to right and market church spire behind. Rich medieval German details and terracotta roofs, clear bright day. Buildings occupy upper 70%, broad unobstructed cobblestone travel lane across foreground lower 25% for an animated car sprite. No foreground crowds or parked vehicles. Recognizable real Marktplatz, not generic European town.
